'''Jabba's bunker''' was a secret location maintained by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in the [[Swallowing Wastes]]. Aboveground the bunker was an egg-shaped structure, but extended into an underground complex. A camouflaged [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] in the nearby mountains housed at least six [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]]. Shortly after Jabba's death, [[Swang]] and his [[Swang's Swoopers|swoop gang]] took control of the bunker.<ref name="Perdition" />
